body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-15 15:24Z, learned from my own wrong LAUNCH NOW). Match the gate-launch form to the worker's RUNTIME:
- Claude worker: one Bash call in background mode, `pushd "C:\…\worktree" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-8112`, nothing chained.
- Codex worker (Termal::Merger, the Sol-* coders, Codex-*): its NATIVE command, with workdir set to the worktree and command `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-8112`. Codex's /bin/bash can't pushd into a Windows path; it fails with "No such file or directory" and nothing launches.
I sent the Merger (Codex) the Claude pushd form for w-c538. It refused cleanly at 15:16Z and asked, and the gate start slipped about 10 min. Check the worker's runtime before writing the form.
